data.question: The first Star Wars film was released the same year Elvis Presley died. Was it the 1960s, 1970s or 1980s?
data.explanation: The 1970s (1977). Elvis died in August 1977, three months after Star Wars opened.
data.answer_full: The 1970s (1977). Elvis died in August 1977, three months after Star Wars opened.
